dialogues.text: With Ajax constantly bringing back medicine from his travels, father's headaches have gotten much better!
But out of my three older brothers, Ajax is the only one who rarely comes home. Every time he promises to play with me and Teucer, he bails on us nine times out of ten!
But, as long as he's still willing to play with us, I don't mind.
I just always feel like... if we aren't right there holding his hand, he'll suddenly slip away to a place where nobody can ever reach him.
